name: L
source:
Gentle / Obsessive / Unreadable

The perfect student council president.

Gentle, capable, and impossibly composed, L always seems to know what you need before you even say it. To everyone else, he is flawless.

But the closer you get to him, the more you may begin to wonder whether his kindness is truly meant to save you, or to keep you exactly where he wants you.

[From [url=https://mimu2026.itch.io/empty-box]official itch.io page[/url]]
